name: Suki na Hito
source:
The protagonist loves a classmate on the basketball team......He gathers his courage waiting for the chance to declare his feelings. 
Original heartwarming stalking novel game. Random options will appear, boost his confidence, and help him to his love confession.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE115495.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角爱上了篮球队的一位同学……他鼓起勇气等待着表白的机会。
原创暖心追踪小说游戏。随机选项会出现，增强他的信心，帮助他告白。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE115495.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
